body:
i will never be normal about this one 🧶

in the 'willow' video she spends the whole thing holding onto one golden thread. it's not just a pretty visual — it's a direct payoff to a motif she planted a whole album earlier.

the thing you couldn't see before, now gold in her hands. plant in folklore, payoff in evermore.

so: which exact song is that golden string resolving? we lined up every clue and its payoff in the Clue Web so you can trace it and settle it yourself.

tag the friend who keeps a running list of her easter eggs 💛

critique.rationale: The IG half of the Clue Web thread hero: the golden thread in 'willow' as the visible payoff of folklore's invisible string, posed as a question that the lens settles. Warm fan-first voice, one verifiable egg, a link, and an honest tag hook. Evermore-era stage photo matches the era the motif resolves into.
